The '''Equadorian natives''' were a tribe who inhabited the Ecuadorian jungle. They watched over the lost [[Temple of Tecobai]] and were typically hostile and aggressive towards strangers.

== History==
In the mid late 1950s, the tribe attacked [[Simon Judeau]], [[Eathon Lambert]] and [[Metz]] on their quest to find the treasures of the Temple of Tecobai. A crazy witch doctor had warned them of the natives, and the trio attempted to escape over a rope bridge across a canyon of liquid hot magma. The tribe's arrows damaged the bridge and Metz nearly fell to his death, however he was saved by Simon and they lived to tell the tale. {{source|The Divine Comedy}}

== Abilities ==
The natives were skilled in combat and armed with an array of weapons including spears, bows and arrows. Their persistence and aggression towards strangers was made clear in the numerous arrows fired at Metz, Simon and Eathon. {{source|The Divine Comedy}}
